#611 · Axe Jaw Pokémon

Fraxure

Dragon

Unova · Generation 5

Fraxure is a Dragon-type Axe Jaw Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 36 kg. It evolves from Axew and into Haxorus. Its highest base stat is Attack (117), with a base stat total of 410.
